title: Systems of nonlocal conservation laws: well-posedness and the singular limit for a nonlocal generalized Aw-Rascle-Zhang model
summary: In this paper, we study a system of nonlocal conservation laws motivated by traffic flow: a nonlocal version of the generalized Aw-Rascle-Zhang (GARZ) model. The nonlocality arises from downstream spatial averaging of the velocity by a one-sided kernel. We prove the existence and uniqueness of weak solutions for initial data of bounded variation via a fixed-point argument in the nonlocal velocity.
